decisions_log.notes: Batch opened by operator decision at the ui-next-batch-02 PDR gate. Four defects, each with an executed reproduction already on record. Scope rule accepted for the successor batch: it repairs exactly what its own stories make newly reachable, and nothing more.

This batch changes NO frozen interface. The ViewState/IRenderer migration and the Canvas dots/bgs work stay in the parked feature batch. Rationale: a repair PR whose diff also moves two frozen interfaces is not a sharper gate, which was the whole argument for splitting.

Increment 3 BLOCKED on F1 (HIGH, dead computation in resolve_document). Fixed via option A (walk deleted, not de-recursed), battery re-run 20 arms, re-gated PASS with 0 HIGH. At the re-gate the v2 transcript was found never landed in 03-increments/ - the packet cited a superseded 18-arm run over a tree that no longer existed. Caught by hash comparison, not by reading.

Increment 4 BLOCKED on F1 (HIGH): AT-R14's limb (b) intersected rstripped rows with width-padded rows - 0 of 28 eligible to match - and one arm mutated both clip conjuncts at once, leaving the column clip unguarded. Fixed to four limbs; L8 split into L8a/L8b, each reddening AT-R14. F2 taken as C-40 prescribes (new predicate TC-R36, not a re-argument).

Security CLEAR TO MERGE, 0 HIGH. M1/M3 closed as a CLASS by TC-R38 (AST census, derived set, no exemption list, own vacuity guard) rather than sink-by-sink - the same defect had been found six times across three reviews. M2's attribution was WRONG: the proposed _coerce_field guard was written, executed and measured unreachable; the real raise is inside yaml.safe_load. Fix narrowed to a typed Spanish refusal, because treating the sidecar as absent would blank every ficha and save would write that back.

Whole-branch QA CLEAR TO MERGE, 0 HIGH, conditional on PM-1 (prototypes/ not gitignored - git add -A staged 5 files) and PM-2 (the traceability registry claimed 18 AT / 38 TC against 22 / 48 on disk). Both applied. Every remaining finding touching mapper/ or tests/ was CARRIED, not fixed: the gate had cleared on that tree and the session had just been recorded (P-1) for editing a tree mid-gate.

Four defects repaired, 245 -> 429 tests. Post-mortem records eight orchestrator process defects alongside the code findings, including four instances of one pattern - the work was done and the record was not landed (unlanded v2 transcript, A-9, A-10, the registry). Sharpest finding: backlog B-07/B-10 already named the notify sink class at the batch-01 close, and that gate closed CONDITIONALLY on a census never written; the class then cost six rediscoveries. A gate that closes conditionally has not closed.
